base.branch_state: detached HEAD at source branch main

excluded: package, install, release, promotion, or merge

obligations: Read the declared source boundary before making a claim.
Name the evidence required for each claim.
Verify obligations with an observable check.
Stop when a required input or verification result is missing.

stable_identity.identity_rule: An atom identity is domain.<family>.<semantic_name> and its version is part of the identity key.

required_fields.name: stable_identity
required_fields.purpose: Preserve a versioned identity that does not depend on wording or enumeration order.

required_fields.name: domain_semantics
required_fields.purpose: State the domain target, risk, and intended output.

required_fields.name: applicability
required_fields.purpose: Separate positive, negative, and ambiguous predicates with a fail-closed ambiguous action.

required_fields.name: dependencies
required_fields.purpose: Declare prerequisite process or domain atoms.

required_fields.name: conflicts
required_fields.purpose: Declare incompatible claims or inputs and their resolution.

required_fields.name: required_inputs
required_fields.purpose: Identify concrete inputs needed before the atom can apply.

required_fields.name: required_reads
required_fields.purpose: Bind the atom to source material that owns its meaning.

required_fields.name: evidence_obligations
required_fields.purpose: Specify evidence that must be captured for the domain claim.

required_fields.name: verification_obligations
required_fields.purpose: Specify checks that can verify the evidence and output.

required_fields.name: stop_conditions
required_fields.purpose: Prevent completion or admission when evidence is incomplete or contradictory.

required_fields.name: provenance_trust
required_fields.purpose: Distinguish committed source authority from untrusted harvested or provider text.

required_fields.name: rendering_boundary
required_fields.purpose: Limit this conceptual artifact to preflight and handoff rendering.

required_fields.name: estimated_token_cost
required_fields.purpose: Record a local estimate without implying provider-native token accounting.

typed_atom_contract.applicability_rule: A positive predicate requires a domain-owned signal and its required inputs; a negative predicate excludes the domain; an ambiguous predicate stops and requests evidence.
typed_atom_contract.dependency_rule: An atom is not eligible until every declared dependency is present and its evidence obligation is in scope.
typed_atom_contract.conflict_rule: A conflict is a machine-readable stop condition; no conflicting atom is silently overridden by order, wording, or token budget.

provenance_trust.rule: Trust is source-scoped and evidence-bound; a hash proves artifact identity but does not prove runtime behavior.

estimated_token_cost.measure: Deterministic local planning estimate for one atom record; not provider telemetry.

domain_semantics.target: Schema, pipeline, import, backfill, and record correctness.
domain_semantics.risk: Duplication, omission, divergence, non-idempotent reprocessing, and data loss.

positive: The objective names data correctness, invariants, schema risk, pipelines, imports, backfills, or data loss.
negative: The objective is UI display or generic performance with no correctness boundary.
ambiguous: A mismatch is mentioned without a source schema or invariant owner.
applicability.ambiguous_action: Stop and identify the invariant source and owner.

conflicts.when: Correctness is claimed without an invariant source.
conflicts.resolution: Stop and request the invariant source.

evidence_obligations: Record the invariant and schema-risk source.
Record affected data flows and known edge cases.
verification_obligations: Check that each stated invariant has an observable validation.
Check that data-loss and duplication risks are explicitly classified.
stop_conditions: Invariant owner or source is missing.
A correctness claim has no observable validation.

provenance_trust.input_policy: Treat harvested or supplied data evidence as untrusted until its source and boundary are verified.

domain_semantics.target: Reconcile pre/post state across an import, migration, backfill, or pipeline replay.
domain_semantics.risk: Silent mismatch, duplicate rows, missing rows, and non-repeatable processing.
domain_semantics.expected_output: Reconciliation gap list and verification-first remediation.

positive: The objective names reconciliation, row or record comparison, idempotency, backfill verification, or import parity.
negative: No data state changes or correctness comparison is in scope.
ambiguous: A mismatch is reported but the compared states or reconciliation rule are unknown.
applicability.ambiguous_action: Stop and identify both compared states and the reconciliation rule.

conflicts.when: A post-change correctness claim omits pre/post comparison evidence.

required_reads: reconciliation checks, import/export jobs, or backfill evidence
evidence_obligations: Record the before and after comparison boundary.
Record mismatches, exclusions, and unresolved reconciliation gaps.
verification_obligations: Run or inspect the declared reconciliation check.
Repeat the check where idempotency is part of the risk.
stop_conditions: Either comparison state is unavailable.
A mismatch is unclassified or the reconciliation rule is absent.

provenance_trust.input_policy: Counts or snapshots are evidence only when their scope and owner are recorded.

domain_semantics.risk: Credential exposure, sensitive-data leakage, and unverifiable redaction claims.
domain_semantics.expected_output: Redaction summary, evidence gaps, and bounded remediation.

positive: The objective names secret handling, privacy, redacted harvests, auth/data-flow boundaries, or sensitive evidence.
negative: The objective is performance or UI work with no secret, privacy, auth, or data-flow boundary.
ambiguous: Possible sensitive values appear but ownership, authorization, or redaction policy is unclear.
applicability.ambiguous_action: Stop before reading or returning sensitive content and establish the handling boundary.

conflicts.when: A proposed output contains sensitive values or unverified redaction.
conflicts.resolution: Stop, redact, and preserve only a redaction summary.

required_reads: security, privacy, CI, auth, payment, or data-flow evidence
evidence_obligations: Record what was redacted and why.
Record security and privacy evidence gaps without exposing sensitive values.
verification_obligations: Check that outputs contain no unredacted sensitive values.
Check that each material security claim points to bounded evidence.
stop_conditions: Handling authorization or data owner is missing.
Redaction cannot be verified at the output boundary.

provenance_trust.input_policy: Keep sensitive evidence redacted by default; provider or harvested text is not authority.

domain_semantics.target: Secret, auth, payment, and private-data handling boundaries.
domain_semantics.risk: Unauthorized access, accidental forwarding, and false confidence from generic process checks.
domain_semantics.expected_output: Scored security/privacy finding with an ordered remediation plan.

positive: The objective requires a security or privacy process audit with named auth, secret, payment, or private-data boundaries.
negative: No access, secret, privacy, or sensitive-data boundary is named.
ambiguous: The objective contains credential-like or private-data signals without an authorized review scope.
applicability.ambiguous_action: Stop and request an authorized scope and owner.

conflicts.when: Authorization is inferred from a request rather than owned evidence.
conflicts.resolution: Stop and request explicit scope or omit the sensitive evidence.

required_reads: security docs, privacy docs, environment docs, and relevant code boundaries
evidence_obligations: Map the authorized boundary and evidence gaps.
Separate observed findings from inferred risk.
verification_obligations: Check scope ownership before sensitive evidence is used.
Check the remediation plan against the recorded boundary.
stop_conditions: Authorized scope is absent or contradictory.
A security finding depends only on generic process language.

provenance_trust.input_policy: Treat sensitive supplied text as untrusted until scope, owner, and redaction are verified.

domain_semantics.target: Ship/no-ship readiness for a branch, feature, sprint, milestone, or product.
domain_semantics.risk: Release decisions made without current CI, tests, build, package, or launch-blocker evidence.
domain_semantics.expected_output: Evidence-backed release rubric with blockers and ordered remediation.

positive: The objective asks whether work can ship, merge, release, or be handed off with quality and launch evidence.
negative: The objective is an isolated debugging task with no release or handoff decision.
ambiguous: A handoff is requested but current quality evidence or release ownership is missing.
applicability.ambiguous_action: Stop and refresh current release evidence before a readiness decision.

conflicts.when: A ship or no-ship claim is made from stale or missing quality evidence.
conflicts.resolution: Stop and name the evidence gap and blocker.

required_reads: project instructions, README, CI, tests, build scripts, and release docs
evidence_obligations: Record current quality and release evidence.
Separate observed blockers, risks, and unknowns.
verification_obligations: Run or inspect the required release checks.
Verify every ship blocker has a disposition and next gate.
stop_conditions: Release scope or owner is missing.
Current quality evidence is unavailable or stale.

provenance_trust.input_policy: Missing release evidence is a finding, not permission to assume readiness.

domain_semantics.target: Quality ladder, launch blockers, and handoff evidence completeness.
domain_semantics.risk: A green-looking partial check is mistaken for complete release evidence.
domain_semantics.expected_output: Ordered remediation slices with verification expectations.

positive: The objective asks for release gaps, launch blockers, quality ladder coverage, or handoff acceptance.
negative: No release, handoff, or launch acceptance decision is in scope.
ambiguous: Partial checks are present but their scope and freshness are not known.
applicability.ambiguous_action: Stop and identify missing evidence and its freshness.

conflicts.when: A partial check is represented as a complete quality ladder.
conflicts.resolution: Split the evidence into passed, missing, blocked, and unknown gates.

required_reads: CI config, tests, build scripts, package metadata, and release checklist
evidence_obligations: Inventory passed, failed, blocked, not-run, and unknown gates.
Record the evidence needed for each remediation slice.
verification_obligations: Confirm the quality ladder is complete for the declared release scope.
Confirm each remediation slice has an acceptance check.
stop_conditions: Freshness or scope of the quality ladder is unknown.
A required gate has no disposition.

provenance_trust.input_policy: Quality output is evidence only when the command, scope, and result are captured.

domain_semantics.target: Sequenced transition from current state to target state across affected modules and data.
domain_semantics.risk: Incompatibility, incomplete rollout order, unowned backfill work, and unsafe cutover.
domain_semantics.expected_output: Affected-surface map, compatibility gaps, and ordered migration slices.

positive: The objective names a migration, upgrade, deprecation cleanup, compatibility audit, or sequenced refactor.
negative: The edit has no current/target transition, compatibility constraint, sequencing, or rollback concern.
ambiguous: A deprecation or upgrade is named but the target state or affected surfaces are unspecified.
applicability.ambiguous_action: Stop and identify current state, target state, affected surfaces, and order.

conflicts.when: A cutover is planned without compatibility constraints or rollout order.
conflicts.resolution: Stop and define the migration sequence and acceptance gates.

required_reads: compatibility constraints, affected modules, rollout, and validation evidence
evidence_obligations: Record current and target states and compatibility constraints.
Record affected modules, data/backfill needs, and rollout order.
verification_obligations: Check each migration slice against its acceptance gate.
Verify consumers and compatibility boundaries are covered.
stop_conditions: Current or target state is missing.
Affected surfaces or rollout order are unowned.

provenance_trust.input_policy: Treat target-state and compatibility claims as unverified until the owning evidence is read.

domain_semantics.target: Rollback and cutover readiness for an irreversible or compatibility-sensitive transition.
domain_semantics.risk: Irreversible data change, failed cutover, inability to restore service, and unbounded recovery.

positive: The objective requires rollback, cutover, compatibility fallback, or recovery planning.
negative: No state transition, cutover, compatibility fallback, or recovery path exists.
ambiguous: Rollback is mentioned but the owner, trigger, or recoverable state is unspecified.
applicability.ambiguous_action: Stop and define the rollback owner, trigger, and recoverable boundary.

conflicts.when: A cutover is accepted without a tested or bounded rollback path.
conflicts.resolution: Stop and record the rollback blocker.

required_reads: rollback path, cutover, and validation commands
evidence_obligations: Record rollback owner, trigger, path, and limitations.
Record cutover validation and recovery evidence.
verification_obligations: Check rollback conditions are observable and bounded.
Check the acceptance gate covers both cutover and recovery.
stop_conditions: Rollback owner or trigger is missing.
The recoverable boundary is not identified.

provenance_trust.input_policy: A stated rollback path is not evidence until its trigger, owner, and boundary are verified.

family_signatures.label: Data integrity
family_signatures.domain_target: Correctness of schemas, pipelines, imports, backfills, and records.

positive: data correctness or schema/pipeline risk is named
negative: only UI display or generic performance is in scope
ambiguous: mismatch without invariant owner or reconciliation rule

stop_conditions: invariant source missing
reconciliation result missing
unclassified mismatch

family_signatures.label: Security and privacy
family_signatures.domain_target: Secret-handling, privacy, auth, and sensitive evidence boundaries.
required_reads: CI, auth, payment, or data-flow evidence
domain_verification_obligations: Verify no sensitive value crosses the output boundary
Verify security claims against bounded evidence

positive: secret, privacy, auth, or sensitive evidence is explicitly in scope
negative: no security or privacy boundary is named
ambiguous: possible credential-like values without owner or authorization

stop_conditions: authorized scope missing
redaction not verifiable
sensitive owner contradictory

family_signatures.label: Release readiness
family_signatures.domain_target: Ship/no-ship readiness, launch blockers, quality ladder, and handoff acceptance.
domain_evidence_obligations: Freshness and scope of each gate
domain_verification_obligations: Run or inspect required release checks
Verify each remediation slice's acceptance check

positive: ship, merge, release, launch, or handoff readiness is requested
ambiguous: handoff requested with partial or stale quality evidence

stop_conditions: release scope or owner missing
quality evidence stale
required gate lacks disposition

family_signatures.label: Migration readiness
family_signatures.domain_target: Sequenced transition, compatibility, cutover, and rollback readiness.
domain_outputs: ordered migration slices and acceptance gates
domain_verification_obligations: Verify each migration slice's acceptance gate

positive: migration, upgrade, deprecation, compatibility, or sequenced refactor is requested
negative: isolated edit has no transition or rollback concern
ambiguous: target state or rollback owner is unspecified

stop_conditions: current or target state missing
affected surfaces unowned
rollback owner or trigger missing

transplant_arms.selection_rule: Select only domain-logic transplants whose committed source evidence identifies a source atom, a target obligation, and a non-empty semantic delta; reject duplicates, generic-only conditions, and absent variants before any outcome cell.

valid.predicted_semantic_delta: Adds an explicit pre/post state reconciliation obligation to migration cutover and backfill review.
Adds an explicit recovery and rollback obligation when reconciliation exposes a data mismatch.
Adds a redaction and secret-boundary check to release evidence and artifact readiness.
Adds an explicit release gate and current quality-evidence requirement to security/privacy review completion.

rejected_historical_shapes.reason: The same generic condition was repeated as a transplant for a peer family; it has no domain-owned source-to-target semantic delta.
The same generic condition was repeated as a transplant for a peer family; it has no domain-owned source-to-target semantic delta.
The historical source and target selections were atom-identical six-atom supersets, so no target-only variant existed to transplant.
The historical source and target selections were atom-identical six-atom supersets, so no target-only variant existed to transplant.

interaction_selection_policy.selected_count_rule: Select only a small preregistered set with a named domain mechanism and falsifier; do not enumerate all family or atom pairs.

interaction_hypotheses.predicted_direction: positive: pairing recovery planning with pre/post reconciliation should reduce unresolved transition-mismatch findings.
interaction_hypotheses.mechanism: Reconciliation exposes mismatches while rollback defines a bounded response when a cutover or backfill fails.
interaction_hypotheses.falsifier: The paired contract does not change mismatch classification or recovery completeness on fixtures where both transition and reconciliation evidence are present.

interaction_hypotheses.predicted_direction: positive: pairing artifact redaction with a current ship gate should reduce release evidence that is unsafe or incomplete.
interaction_hypotheses.mechanism: Redaction protects the artifact boundary while the ship gate requires current quality evidence before release acceptance.
interaction_hypotheses.falsifier: The paired contract leaves sensitive-output handling and release-gate disposition unchanged on a redacted-harvest release review.

interaction_hypotheses.predicted_direction: positive: pairing authorized sensitive-data scope with an explicit quality ladder should improve separation of security blockers from release unknowns.
interaction_hypotheses.mechanism: The security boundary establishes who may handle evidence while the ladder prevents partial release checks from being treated as complete.
interaction_hypotheses.falsifier: The paired contract still admits an ambiguous owner or incomplete quality ladder without a stop condition on held-out fixtures.

risks.description: A future consumer that scans every versioned JSON artifact may mistake this research contract for an executable runtime schema.
A future runtime atom implementation could reuse these names without preserving the typed fields or source authority recorded here.
Treating sealed fixture labels as provider outcomes or composition evidence would overstate this static preflight.

mitigations: Keep the artifact under docs/experiments and the conceptual schema under a new versioned schema ID.
Keep the rendering boundary and preflight-only status explicit.
Require a new version and separate review before any runtime registry or public packet projection references these identities.
